description: This file defines the `I18NLangString` class, which represents a language string entity used for internationalization within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties like `unitId`, `group`, `value`, `note`, `version`, and relations to translations, with ORM mappings for database persistence.

classes.name: I18NLangString
classes.description: Entity class representing a language string with associated metadata and translations for internationalization.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit identifier for the language string.

methods.name: setUnitId
methods.description: Sets the unit identifier for the language string.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the associated I18NGroup entity, if any.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Associates an I18NGroup with this language string.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the optional note associated with the language string.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the optional note for the language string.
